theorem to_draw_parallel_line (A : Point) (B C : Point) (BC : Line) (h1 : distinctPointsOnLine B C BC) (h2 : A ≠ B) : ∃ D : Point, A.onLine (lineThroughPoints A D) ∧ ¬(lineThroughPoints A D).intersectsLine BC := by sorry

reference_formalization: ∀ (a b c : Point) (BC : Line), distinctPointsOnLine b c BC ∧ ¬(a.onLine BC) → ∃ EF : Line, a.onLine EF ∧ ¬(EF.intersectsLine BC)
